payload.core_mechanism_summary: Computes block index from n//3, derives t1 via base-4 pattern, generates t2 using bit-pair mapping on binary, and t3 = t1 XOR t2.
payload.rationale: The solution directly computes the n-th element using bit manipulation and XOR property without any search. The mapping of bit pairs encodes the XOR-0 triple generation, fitting bit_xor_trick.
